caption: Two servers run all 24 hours at ₹432; eight more join only for the 4-hour peak at ₹288, so the elastic group pays ₹720, while 10 servers kept all day cost ₹2,160.

spec.aria: A 24-hour timeline: 2 base servers run the whole day costing ₹432, 8 extra servers run only the 4-hour peak costing ₹288 giving ₹720 in total, and below them 10 servers kept all day cost ₹2,160.
